svg.title: Divided Berlin, The Refugee Brain Drain and Construction of the Berlin Wall (1958–61)
svg.desc: High-resolution ALKIS Ortsteile GIS map of Greater Berlin surrounded by East Germany (GDR), showing the French, British, American, and Soviet sectors, the exact 155 km Berlin Wall ring (112 km outer encirclement and 43 km inner-city sector wall built from 13 August 1961), Checkpoint Charlie, Brandenburg Gate, Bernauer Strasse, Potsdamer Platz, Schöneberg Rathaus, and West Berlin's three airfields (Tegel, Gatow, Tempelhof).

g.text: 155 KM BERLIN WALL ENCIRCLEMENT RING (13 AUG 1961)
